instruction: Please set DuckDuckGo as my default search engine in the browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Chrome to use DuckDuckGo as the default search engine. Uses existing getter get_default_search_engine and metric match_in_list to verify the configuration. The task is similar in complexity to the original Bing configuration task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_default_search_engine correctly extracts the default search engine name from Chrome Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric match_in_list correctly checks if the result matches the expected value by testing result in expected list
Expected value "DuckDuckGo" is semantically correct - this is the exact short_name that Chrome stores for DuckDuckGo search engine
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage - instruction requires setting DuckDuckGo as default search engine, and evaluator verifies exactly that requirement
Data flow is correct: user changes setting → postconfig persists → getter reads Preferences → metric compares → verification succeeds
